fact: In an interview of 2 October 2024 CNDP president Omar Seghrouchni said disciplinary proceedings against TLS Contact Maroc, VFS GCC Morocco and BLSMOR Services were still open, that the CNDP refers non-compliant controllers to the public prosecutor, and that its published annual activity reports are far behind, with a five-year report in preparation.
title: Omar Seghrouchni (CNDP) : « L'investissement n'absout pas les violations des données personnelles »
